title: Condensation and Non-condensation in the Quasilinear 4-wave Kinetic Equation
summary: We study finite-time condensation at zero frequency for the isotropic quasilinear 4-wave kinetic equation in three dimensions. With Schrodinger dispersion and a product interaction coefficient with exponent $β\in(0,3/4]$, we construct global measure solutions $(g_t)_{t\geq0}$ for every nonnegative initial measure $g_0$ with finite wave action and energy. We then establish the sharp threshold $β=1/4$ for finite-time condensation of the constructed solutions.
